# Sarad Gajurel — Lead Software Engineer

> Personal portfolio and project showcase for Sarad Gajurel, a Lead Software Engineer from Kathmandu, Nepal with 5+ years of experience in Flutter mobile development, Node.js SaaS platforms, and .NET enterprise systems.

## About

Sarad Gajurel is a Lead Software Engineer at Pioneer Associate Pvt. Ltd. (2020–present) where he heads the Mobile App & Web Services Unit and leads a cross-functional team of up to 11 engineers. He has shipped 100+ white-label mobile banking apps, a multi-method payment platform, ERP systems, and multiple SaaS products. He also independently publishes Android apps on Google Play under the ICT Solved! brand.

- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Email: saradgajurel@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/ictsolved
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/saradgajurel

## Skills

- Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Android, App Flavors/White-labeling, Firebase
- Backend: Node.js, Laravel (PHP), .NET Core, ASP.NET Blazor, REST API Design
- Frontend: React, Nuxt.js, Vue.js, JavaScript
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, SQL Server
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Nginx, CI/CD, Git, Linux

## Professional Projects

- CoSys Apps — 100+ white-label mobile banking Flutter apps for cooperative banks across Nepal, deployed via CI/CD
- Check Writer — Flutter payment platform supporting checks, eChecks, ACH, credit/debit, wire, and wallet transfers
- ZenithFlow ERP — Flutter + Laravel enterprise ERP with ZK biometric device integration (attendance, payroll)
- Waste Management SaaS — Node.js + PostgreSQL + Docker multi-tenant SaaS for waste management companies
- Restaurant Management SaaS — Node.js + React + MongoDB single-vendor restaurant management platform
- Manpower System — ASP.NET Blazor + PostgreSQL SaaS HR system for recruiting agencies
